meta.subject: mshr entry match id changed when missreq missrsp conflict fixed

en.summary: The commit fixes an L1 MSHR control bug by only capturing the matching entry ID when a miss request fires, preventing conflicts from retargeting the active MSHR entry.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly describes an MSHR conflict bug.
The patch changes central L1 cache miss-handling logic, not tooling or tests.
The changed register-enable condition directly affects which MSHR entry is updated.
disqualifiers: The commit also contains a large log file update.
The hardware change itself is only one line, so the decision relies on the surrounding MSHR context.
evidence: The modified register feeds logic immediately below `secondaryMiss` and `primaryMiss` handling.
The commit message names the exact scenario: miss request and miss response conflict causing the matched entry ID to change.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A cache MSHR that merges secondary misses into existing outstanding misses has to remember which entry matched at the time the new request commits. If the matched-entry ID keeps sampling every cycle instead of being frozen on the request handshake, unrelated probe or response activity can retarget the merge to a different entry before allocation completes.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: MSHR matched-entry capture for secondary-miss merge
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A probe finds a matching MSHR entry while the miss request is stalled or overlaps a miss response or other activity that can change the match result.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Continuously update the remembered matched-entry ID every cycle instead of latching it only when the miss request handshake commits.
portability_notes: Apply this where a secondary miss is merged into an existing miss-status entry.
The bug requires a decoupled request interface or any case where probe results can change before allocation or merge commits.
Keep the hit or miss classifier intact; only corrupt the capture of which entry matched.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the register that carries the matched MSHR entry ID from probe stage into the request-allocation stage.
Remove the handshake enable so the register samples the combinational match result every cycle.
Do not change the actual match comparator or entry-valid bits.
Test with backpressure or overlapping miss-response traffic so the match result can change before the request fires.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: MSHR probe-match ID capture used by secondary miss allocation
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix replaces an unconditional RegNext of OHToUInt(entryMatchProbe) with RegEnable(..., io.missReq.fire()) so the matched entry ID is updated only on a real miss-request handshake.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Replace RegEnable(OHToUInt(entryMatchProbe), io.missReq.fire()) with RegNext(OHToUInt(entryMatchProbe)) in L1MSHR.scala.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: A secondary miss can merge into the wrong MSHR entry or lose its merge, leading to corrupted miss tracking, timeouts, or cache pipeline hangs.
evidence_for_injection: The fix changes only the enable condition on the register that remembers the matched entry ID.
That register feeds the address selection used for secondary-miss allocation.
The bug is explicitly described as a miss-request versus miss-response conflict in the commit message.
notes: This is a clean single-site injection target because the semantic bug is completely localized to the latch enable.
The companion log file in the commit is diagnostic evidence only and should not be part of the mutation.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 L1 MSHR 控制错误：只有在 miss request 真正发射时才锁存匹配项 ID，从而避免冲突时活动 MSHR 项被错误改写。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确描述了 MSHR 冲突 bug。
补丁修改的是核心 L1 cache miss 处理逻辑，而不是工具或测试。
被修改的寄存器使能条件会直接影响哪个 MSHR 项被更新。
disqualifiers: 该提交还包含一个很大的日志文件更新。
真正的硬件改动只有一行，因此判断依赖于周边 MSHR 语境。
evidence: `L1MSHR.scala` 把 `val entryMatchProbeid_reg = RegNext(OHToUInt(entryMatchProbe))` 改成了 `RegEnable(OHToUInt(entryMatchProbe), io.missReq.fire())`。
这个寄存器紧邻其下方的 `secondaryMiss` 与 `primaryMiss` 处理逻辑。
提交信息明确指出了具体场景：miss request 与 miss response 冲突时，匹配项 ID 会变化。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 会把 secondary miss 合并到已有 outstanding miss 的 cache MSHR，必须记住“在新请求提交当时匹配到的是哪个 entry”。如果这个 matched-entry ID 仍然每拍采样，而不是在请求握手时冻结，那么在分配完成前，其他 probe 或 response 活动就可能把这次合并重定向到另一个 entry。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 用于 secondary-miss 合并的 MSHR 匹配 entry 捕获
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某次 probe 已经找到匹配的 MSHR entry，但 miss request 被回压，或者与 miss response 等会改变匹配结果的活动重叠。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让记录 matched-entry ID 的寄存器继续每拍更新，而不是只在 miss request 握手成功时锁存。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 对选中 entry ID 使用无门控寄存器
portability_notes: 适用于会把 secondary miss 合并到已有 miss-status entry 的设计。
这种故障通常需要 decoupled 请求接口，或任何 probe 结果在真正分配前还可能变化的情况。
保持 hit/miss 分类逻辑不变，只破坏“匹配的是哪个 entry”的锁存。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到把匹配到的 MSHR entry ID 从 probe 阶段带到 request 分配阶段的那个寄存器。
去掉其握手使能，让该寄存器每个周期都采样组合匹配结果。
不要修改实际的匹配比较器或 entry-valid 位。
在存在回压或 miss-response 重叠的场景下测试，使匹配结果能在请求真正发射前变化。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 用于 secondary miss 分配的 MSHR probe-match ID 锁存逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 补丁把无条件的 RegNext(OHToUInt(entryMatchProbe)) 改成了 RegEnable(..., io.missReq.fire())，从而只在真实的 miss-request 握手时更新匹配 entry ID。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 L1MSHR.scala 中，把 RegEnable(OHToUInt(entryMatchProbe), io.missReq.fire()) 改回 RegNext(OHToUInt(entryMatchProbe))。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: secondary miss 可能被错误地合并到其他 MSHR entry，或者合并丢失，最终导致 miss 跟踪损坏、超时或 cache 管线卡死。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁唯一改变的是记录匹配 entry ID 的寄存器使能条件。
这个寄存器会驱动 secondary miss 分配时的 entry 地址选择。
提交信息直接把该错误描述成 miss-request 与 miss-response 的冲突。
notes: 这是一个非常干净的单点注入目标，因为语义错误完全局限在 latch enable 上。
提交中的日志文件只用于诊断佐证，不应参与故障注入。
